description: A text field with label, hint and error, filled back from the session after a failed submit. Takes any input type, plus prefix, suffix and a leading icon. Works with Livewire wire:model, name optional. Password, number, select and the other form controls are components of their own.

consider.note: `required`, `maxlength`, `pattern` and `type="email"` only shape what the browser lets through; a request can skip them all. Repeat each rule in a Form Request, with `max:` on every string.
Build the model from `$request->validated()`, not `$request->all()`, so fields the form never had (`is_admin`, `user_id`) can't be set.
